data.narrative:
Flamefront Propulsion is a pre-seed stage frontier-tech company in Defense & Security, founded by Matt Garcia, an MIT-trained aeronauticist and former founding engineer and head of propulsion at Mach Industries. The broader Defense & Security sector comprises 23 identifiable peers, of which 2 are publicly traded (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 are private. Top-tier private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Peer-median valuation methodology proved inapplicable. The narrow peer set at pre-seed stage within Defense & Security yielded insufficient datapoints—zero same-stage matches, one adjacent-stage peer, and zero similar-tier comparables—falling short of the three-observation minimum required for reliable median triangulation. Broadening filters across all Defense & Security peers or sector-agnostic cohorts would introduce excessive noise and mask stage-specific and sector-specific dynamics material to this valuation.

The absence of robust quantitative comparables at the pre-seed stage leaves significant uncertainty. A credible valuation range would require either additional private transaction data from contemporaneous pre-seed rounds in adjacent autonomy and defense-tech segments, or application of alternative methods such as founder credential premium scoring or early technical milestone benchmarking—neither of which can be executed from the available data set. Further diligence on recent pre-seed and seed-stage financings among the identified private peer set would be necessary to establish defensible valuation support.
